name: Nokia R4 smart TV (Realtek, R4)
warnings: The com.apps middleware suite: virtualkey, smartkey, fivekey and bluetoothremote are the remote and its key handling - never disable those. smartmenu is the TV's own picture/sound/screen menu (SoundAdjust, WideMode, TunerMode), passthrough the HDMI input path, puresound/audiolink audio - all kept.
Factory tools below were never opened during discovery (enabled only by dumpsys).
